__metaDescription: Withdraw from a contract with MyWorkLog online, without signing in. You receive an acknowledgement of receipt by email straight away.
wrLede.hier_widerrufen_sie_einen_vertrag: Here you can withdraw from a contract with MyWorkLog, for example the purchase of the training pass. No sign-in is needed.
wrHinweise.nach_dem_absenden_erhalten_si: After sending, you immediately receive an acknowledgement of receipt by email, with the content of your declaration and the date and time of receipt.
wrVertragHilfe.zum_beispiel_rechnungsnum: For example invoice number, date of purchase or the email address of your MyWorkLog account.
wrQName.name: Name
wrAnders.sie_koennen_auch_formlos_an: You can also write informally to info@myworklog.de or send a letter to Sven Kunz, Am Moosgraben 32, 91572 Bechhofen, Germany. That counts just the same.
